summary: amazon.aws autoscaling_group parameters for detaching, decrementing and replacing instances are deprecated for removal in 14.0.0, in favor of autoscaling_instance and autoscaling_instance_refresh.
questions: How do I detach instances from an ASG with amazon.aws now?
How do I do a rolling instance refresh with Ansible?

answer_card.title: autoscaling_group instance options deprecated
answer_card.answer_md:
Deprecated in `amazon.aws.autoscaling_group`, removed in release 14.0.0:

- `decrement_desired_capacity`, `detach_instances`, `replace_instances` → manage instances with **`amazon.aws.autoscaling_instance`**.
- `replace_batch_size`, `lc_check`, `lt_check`, `replace_all_instances` → rolling replacement with **`amazon.aws.autoscaling_instance_refresh`**.
